title: Taskip Documentation
description: Everything you need to know about Taskip — the modern task and project management platform.
heroTagline: Manage tasks, projects, and teams — all in one place.

featureCards.title: Task Management
featureCards.description: Create, assign, and track tasks with due dates, priorities, and rich descriptions. Stay on top of everything, nothing slips through.

featureCards.title: Projects & Boards
featureCards.description: Organize work with Kanban boards, Gantt charts, and custom workflows tailored to how your team operates.

featureCards.title: Team Collaboration
featureCards.description: Comment, mention teammates, share files, and keep everyone aligned — no more chasing updates across tools.

featureCards.title: Integrations
featureCards.description: Connect with Slack, GitHub, Zapier, and hundreds of other tools. Taskip fits into your existing workflow.
